speakingPractice.title: Speak clearly with real IELTS-style topics.
speakingPractice.intro: Part 1, Part 2 cue cards, and Part 3 discussion questions built for Uzbek learners: vocabulary, phrases, sample answers, mistakes, and practical tips in one calm practice flow.
speakingPractice.progressHint: Finish a topic after practising the questions and reviewing the vocabulary.
speakingPractice.completeHintCue: Record an attempt and rate it first
speakingPractice.completeHintQuestions: Work through all the questions first
speakingPractice.answerShape: Answer naturally: direct answer → reason → example → short final idea.
speakingPractice.planningHint: Not exam questions — use these during the one minute of preparation.
speakingPractice.modelHint: Notice how the answer works through all four bullet points in order. Try your own version first — the timer is on the right.
speakingPractice.hintIdle: Start with one minute of planning, then speak for two minutes.
speakingPractice.hintPrep: Use this minute to write keywords.
speakingPractice.hintSpeak: Keep speaking until the timer ends.
speakingPractice.hintFinished: Great. Rate your performance and repeat once if needed.
speakingPractice.adviceNeedsWork: Run it again and focus on one bullet you rushed. Speaking the same card twice is the fastest way to improve fluency.
speakingPractice.adviceGood: Solid. Next time, add one specific detail — a name, a number, a place — to each bullet. Detail is what moves an answer past band 6.
speakingPractice.adviceStrong: Now compare with the model answer and note any phrase you could reuse. Then move on to a new cue card.
speakingPractice.spinnerHint: Just like the exam — you do not see the question in advance. Spin it and try answering straight away.
speakingPractice.spinnerEmpty: No questions found for this part.
